acceptance_criteria.statement: Looking up a current code location returns the persisted requirement and evidence paths that reach it.
A reverse path reports stale or conflicted links instead of presenting them as current.

content.statement: As an architect, I can begin with changed code and discover the affected requirements, designs, tests, and personas so I can understand the change's system-wide consequences.
content.title: Discover intent affected by code

state.reason: Confirmed after the initial implementation investigation.
